summary_en: 11,104,900 shares at ¥2,701.5/share; ¥29,999,887,350 total; 9.6% of shares outstanding ex-treasury; ToSTNeT-3 single-day block on 2026-06-12; settlement after 08:45 JST close.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Shares via Off-Exchange Proprietary Trade (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 11 June 2026, Kubota Corporation announced a single-day block acquisition of treasury shares via ToSTNeT-3. The company will place an order to purchase 11,104,900 shares at the closing price of ¥2,701.5 per share (total ¥29,999,887,350) on 12 June 2026 at 08:45 JST, during the opening off-exchange proprietary trade session. This block represents 9.6% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury), calculated against the disclosure reference of 1,500 million shares as the program ceiling announced by the board on 21 April 2026. The board simultaneously authorized a maximum aggregate buyback of ¥30 billion and up to 15 million shares through 18 December 2026. As of 11 June 2026, zero shares had been acquired under the program. The order is valid for that trading session only; execution is contingent on matching sell orders at the posted price.
